findings.observation: The render retains Yasin’s light skin, split crop, brow notch, straight nose, and nose stud, but the enlarged smooth face and eye treatment lose sufficient mature age-30 and source-specific geometry cues to read younger and more generic than the verified summon.
The short soft-round build remains recognizable through the evident middle, compact torso, gentle limb contours, and grounded stance without generic body inflation.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands remain proportionate to Yasin’s soft-round source body; neither fists nor limbs are generically enlarged.
The short textured crop preserves the matte black-and-white split streak, swept front, close side silhouette, and exactly three metal hair rings; exactly one tiny nose stud is also visible.

The lilac-smoke fitted vest, soft shirt, high-waist trousers, divided hem, broad collar, flexible boots, three hair rings, and one nose stud remain faithful, but the source-visible blunt carpenter’s chalk is absent from both hands.
At original 1024×1536 resolution, the complete head-and-hair unit occupies approximately 40% of standing figure height, about 2.5 heads total, outside the frozen 32–36% / 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one full-body subject appears, with complete hair, head, both hands, both boots, garment edges, and grounding shadow inside generous safe margins.
The grounded ready-idle stance, separated boots, readable empty hands, split-crop silhouette, and strong lilac/smoke garment blocks remain clear at combat-icon scale.

The practical cloth outfit and simple hardware remain grounded mortal one-star design with no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
